note: The warehouse's routing table. One entry per table. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/warehouse-map.js write` to regenerate the per-table files; `check` fails CI when this file, the generated files, the migrations and the code disagree. The SQL copy lives in football.warehouse_map (migration 0007).

layers.ledger: How data got here: ingest receipts and schema versions.
layers.identity: Who and what: teams and players, and every provider id that points at them.
layers.facts: What happened on the field, from public nflverse data. Never edited by Omen.
layers.provider: Third-party numbers Omen stores but does not own (projections). Kept separate and labelled.
layers.sight: Omen's own numbers, computed from facts. Versioned, and graded against what happened.

tables.name: warehouse_schema_migrations
tables.grain: one row per applied migration
tables.source: the migration apply scripts in warehouse/migrations
tables.purpose: The warehouse's schema version. The app refuses a warehouse whose version it does not accept.

tables.name: warehouse_ingest_events
tables.grain: one row per dataset load (run, dataset, season)
tables.purpose: Receipt for every load: source url and hash, row counts, state. Every fact row cites one.

tables.name: football_teams
tables.grain: one row per franchise
tables.purpose: NFL teams with their nflverse abbreviation and active seasons.

tables.name: football_players
tables.grain: one row per NFL player ever (GSIS)
tables.purpose: Every NFL player with position and birth date. Rookies arrive here when nflverse lists them; retired players stay.
gaps: No per-season status (rookie, active, practice squad, IR, retired): derived from nfl_weekly_rosters today, not stored.

tables.name: football_player_ids
tables.grain: one row per (provider, provider id)
tables.source: nflverse players (GSIS, ESPN) and the Sleeper player list (Sleeper, Yahoo, matched by GSIS)
tables.purpose: The player index: every provider id (GSIS, ESPN, Sleeper, Yahoo) pointing at one Omen player. Grading, usage and projections resolve through it.
gaps: A Yahoo id is indexed only where Sleeper lists it; players Sleeper does not map stay unindexed for Yahoo.

tables.name: nfl_games
tables.grain: one row per game
tables.purpose: Schedule and results: kickoff, score, stadium, roof, surface, temperature, wind, rest days, lines, coaches.
gaps: Weather here is the recorded game-day value, not a forecast.

tables.name: nfl_weekly_rosters
tables.grain: one row per (season, week, team, player)
tables.purpose: Who was on which team each week, with depth position and roster status. The source of player lifecycle.

tables.name: nfl_player_weekly_stats
tables.grain: one row per (season, week, season type, player)
tables.purpose: Box-score lines and PPR points per player-week. Grading and projections read it.
gaps: A player who did not record a stat has no row: absence means did-not-play, not unknown.

tables.name: nfl_team_weekly_stats
tables.grain: one row per (season, week, season type, team)
tables.purpose: Team totals per game, the base for matchup and pace reads.

tables.name: nfl_plays
tables.grain: one row per play (partitioned by season, 1999 onward)
tables.purpose: Every play with EPA, WPA, CPOE and the players involved. The raw material for Sight.

tables.name: nfl_player_weekly_opportunity
tables.grain: one row per (season, week, season type, player)
tables.source: derived from nfl_plays by the ingest
tables.purpose: Usage: snaps, routes, carries, targets, red-zone and goal-line work, deep targets.
gaps: Snap counts carry an open rights review; readers select opportunity counts only.

tables.name: football_metric_runs
tables.grain: one row per metric computation (metric, version, season, week)
tables.purpose: Receipt for each Sight computation: which metric, which formula version, when, and whether it succeeded.

tables.name: football_metric_run_inputs
tables.grain: one row per (metric run, ingest event)
tables.purpose: Exactly which fact loads a Sight value was computed from.

tables.name: football_metric_values
tables.grain: one row per (metric run, entity)
tables.purpose: Sight's numbers: one value per player or team per run, with its components.
gaps: Only RAT-QB exists. No Sight value feeds a recommendation yet.

tables.name: projection_fetch_runs
tables.grain: one row per projection fetch (source, season, week)
tables.purpose: Receipt for each third-party projection fetch.
gaps: Migration 0005 is written but not applied to production.

tables.name: player_weekly_projections
tables.grain: one row per (source, season, week, player): the current projection
tables.purpose: The provider's current weekly projection per player, kept apart from Sight.
gaps: Migration 0005 is written but not applied to production. Commercial permission from the provider is pending.

tables.name: player_weekly_projection_versions
tables.grain: one row per change to a projection
tables.purpose: Append-only history of every projection change, so a call can be judged on the number it actually saw.
gaps: Migration 0005 is written but not applied to production.

tables.name: warehouse_map
tables.grain: one row per warehouse table
tables.purpose: This map, inside the warehouse: what each table is, its layer, grain, source, refresh and known gaps. Query it before writing SQL.

tables.name: player_index_runs
tables.grain: one row per player-index load from a non-nflverse source
tables.refresh: daily 07:15 ET, after the player ingest
tables.purpose: Receipt for provider ids indexed from outside nflverse, so every index row says where it came from.

tables.name: team_ids
tables.grain: one row per (provider, provider code, team or defense)
tables.source: provider team numbering and codes, verified against live leagues (migration 0011)
tables.purpose: The team index: provider team and defense codes (Sleeper PHI, ESPN -16012, Yahoo 100033) point at one Omen team.

tables.name: coach_index_runs
tables.grain: one row per coach-graph load
tables.refresh: daily 07:15 ET (backfill once, then the current season)
tables.purpose: Receipt for coach-graph loads, so every coach and assignment says where it came from.

tables.name: coaches
tables.grain: one row per coach
tables.purpose: Coaches keyed by Wikipedia page title, so one coach links across teams and seasons.

tables.name: coach_assignments
tables.grain: one row per (coach, team, season, role)
tables.source: Wikipedia team-season staff lists (CC BY-SA facts, title + revision kept)
tables.purpose: The coach graph: who was head coach, coordinator or assistant head coach for which team each season.
gaps: Play caller is not listed on the pages; inferred scheme influence (Scheme DNA) is a later edge type.
Pages that omit a staff section leave that team-season without assignments.

tables.name: coach_lineage
tables.grain: one row per (staff coach, head coach, team, season)
tables.purpose: Who worked under whom: every staff member and the head coach he served, per team-season. Derived, never typed in.
